{{Top|leg}}
'''H4b''' was a sedative medication that was developed following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. During the occupation, [[Spice/Legends|spice]] became scarce and drug users turned to H4b and other medications due to their addictions.
